## other writing-related thoughts

- I need a clear day (or week)
- I need to read more before I can write
- I write best when I feel inspired
- I need a tidy desk to 
- I will do a big push once this work thing is done
- I only have 20 min, that is not enough time to bother



## You need a system that works for you.

<br>


Academic writing advice is often really prescriptive, but there is no right way. 

<br>

To design a system that works, you need to be think about... 

- when and where you will write
- how you will put the words on the page
- what will make you stick to the plan



## when and where 

- When does your brain work best?
- Where do you have the least interruptions?
- How often can you find pockets of time in the week?
- What is the best way to protect those pockets?
- Where do you like to write? 

## run a experiment

<br>

Template: I will [do something] for [some period of time]

- I will put 4 x 30 min writing slots in my calendar for 4 weeks
- I will write for 20 min while I drink my coffee for 7 days
- I will write at a cafe for 2 hours on Saturday for 3 weeks


Collect some data 

- how many words on the page
- how many papers read
- how you feel about the process


## how will you write


![](thegap.png){width="900px"}


The gap can make writing very slow. 

You rewrite every sentence as it goes on the page. 

Not many sentences get written

## writing is different from editing


:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- write continuously without stopping to edit
- go back and make it sound good
- commit to extensive revision
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](https://donovanmneal.files.wordpress.com/2013/04/revision.jpg)
:::
::::

## writing momentum


:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
Kick start your writing session by writing about ...

- how you are feeling about writing
- what you are feeling stuck on
- what you don't know and need to learn
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](writetolearn.jpeg){width="300px"}
:::
::::

---


## run a experiment

<br>

Template: I will [do something] for [some period of time]

- I will set a timer and write without stopping for 20 min
- I will write about what I am learning  before I start writing my thesis for 5 minutes
- I will write at a cafe for 2 hours on Saturday for 3 weeks


Collect some data 

- how many words on the page
- how many papers read
- how you feel about the process
